SuiteInformation.Title: Ionity Storage
SuiteInformation.Description: The Ionity Storage profile covers SD / eMMC / NVMe / SATA media on edge carriers (Radxa SATA HAT, CM4 carriers, industrial SSDs): Ionity IO-Storage-Edge durable writes, random reads and sequential writes, plus fio direct 4K/1M random and sequential IO, SQLite Speedtest, LevelDB and RocksDB sync-fill and random-read patterns from OpenBenchmarking.org.
SuiteInformation.Maintainer: Johan Wilhelm van Antwerp - Ionity (Pty) Ltd
